text: Cybersecurity is an interdisciplinary field that focuses on protecting the cyber space (including computers, networks, data, applications, etc.) from attacks, destruction, theft or abuse. Its core lies in constructing a "both offensive and defensive" security protection system through technical means and strategy design, to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the digital world. It is not only a "shield" against cyber threats, but also a core discipline for safeguarding the digital rights and interests of countries, enterprises and individuals.
